notes: The manual states single-cell overcharge protection/recovery thresholds and charge/discharge overtemperature thresholds are user-configurable in the app; normalized values are LI-ION factory defaults, not immutable hardware limits or proof of runtime configuration.
The p.6 ±3 mV voltage-acquisition accuracy is an absolute measurement tolerance; it is not a protection-latency bound, calibration certificate, or proof of live runtime configuration.
The EMES mechanism must bind the selected discharge-overtemperature setting explicitly before using a cell rating conditioned on that setting.

Static charge compatibility may conservatively combine the source-backed factory-default 4.2 V / 4.18 V per-cell guard with the ±3 mV acquisition accuracy, but this does not establish calibration drift, protection latency, cell imbalance dynamics, or the live BMS configuration.
The 60 A value is retained in its native current domain; no pulse capability is inferred from the 120 A instantaneous-current entry.

The hash-pinned v20.1.1 manual reports 120 A maximum instantaneous current, while the older official product page reports 100 A peak discharge; EMES does not consume either value as a pulse envelope in this slice.
